before:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am thrilled to apply for the Support Engineer role at Larkspur Freight. As a passionate and results-driven professional, I have always been dedicated to delivering exceptional customer experiences. In today's fast-paced world, leveraging cutting-edge tools is crucial, and I believe my unique skill set makes me the perfect fit for your dynamic team.

At Brightwell Parcels, I spearheaded a transformative initiative that streamlined our help desk. I am confident that I can hit the ground running and add value from day one.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Daniel Okoro
after:
Dear Larkspur Freight team,

I am applying for the support engineer role. At Brightwell Parcels I cut the median first reply time on the help desk from 9 hours to 3 hours by routing tickets with a set of 14 macros. I also wrote 60 help articles, and in six months the share of searches that ended in a ticket fell from 31% to 22%.

From 2019 to 2022 I was an IT technician at Harrow Lane Primary School, where a weekly Python script kept 120 laptops patched. I work with Zendesk, SQL and Postman, and I am on call one week in five for our tracking API.

I would be glad to talk about how your support queue works. I live in Leeds and work remotely.

Daniel Okoro
notes: The before claims a vague initiative and generic passion; the after names the role and gives the three results of the CV with their numbers, in the order a support lead would ask for them. No fact goes beyond the CV; the company is invented, like the CV.

before:

Before I apply, I'd love to pick your brain about whether the role is on call and which help desk you use, and to explore potential synergies. Please let me know if you have some time to connect at your earliest convenience. Any afternoon next week works for me!

Daniel
after:
Hi Priya,

I saw the support engineer opening at Larkspur Freight. Before I apply, I'd like to check whether I would be a good fit for your team. Is the role on call, and which help desk do you use?

A bit of context on why I ask. I have been a support engineer at Brightwell Parcels since June 2022 and I work with Zendesk. I am also on call one week in five for our tracking API, so I know how much the on-call setup shapes the job.

If a short call is easier for you, I'm happy to fit it around your week.

Daniel Okoro
notes: The before buries its two questions under greetings and a request to connect. The after says why he writes and what he wants to find out for both sides, keeps the same two questions, ties the CV facts to why the questions matter, and leaves the timing to the reader.
